visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt and a pearl necklace, stands in a professional office setting. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands while skincare packaging for Soolantra is overlaid on the screen. (2) The visual cuts to extreme close-up photos of facial skin showing redness, texture, and pustules, labeled as severe clinical symptoms. A cartoon animation of a Demodex mite inside a hair follicle is shown to illustrate the biological cause of the skin condition. (3) The speaker demonstrates face washing techniques by pointing to specific areas like her mouth and hairline while instructional text appears. Graphics displaying skincare products from the DRX series with highlighted ingredients like Salicylic Acid and Tea Tree are presented. (4) A close-up shows a hand dispensing a clear, watery lotion onto the palm. The video concludes with a clean graphic design featuring the brand logo 'DRX Series Skincare' on a grey background with white swooping lines.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides an educational deep-dive into skin conditions caused by Demodex mites. It corrects common misconceptions about sensitive skin, teaches proper face-cleansing techniques, and promotes the use of specific skincare ingredients found in the DRX Series Skincare products to control mite population.
